use.flag: Allow the build to fetch npm packages for the host UI (implied by desktop; no offline mode for the UI build is implemented)
Build the engine for NVIDIA GPUs (CUDA backend, sm_75 through sm_120: RTX 20/30/40/50)
Install the Tauri desktop app (strata-desktop): the web shell, a pinned Node.js runtime and a pinned CPython control component; with cuda or hip the app also ships the engine bundle
Build the engine for AMD GPUs (ROCm/HIP backend, gfx1100 and gfx1201: RDNA3/RDNA4)
Link the ggml installed by sci-ml/ggml instead of building the pinned llama.cpp commit's ggml; strata's own ggml-cuda MMQ sources are still compiled, from ggml's installed source tree
Pull dev-python/textual for the terminal's interactive screens (strata launch, strata monitor); without it the screens report a clean error and the --no-tui fallback stays available
